paper_title: The search for low-mass axion dark matter with ABRACADABRA-10cm
notes: Broadband search for axion dark matter with ABRACADABRA-10cm in 0.41-8.27 neV range. World-leading limit g_agamma < 3.2e-11 GeV^-1 at ma ~ 2.99 neV (95% CL). Data points approximated from Fig. 4; exact tabulated data available at github.com/joshwfoster/ABRA_Results_2020. SHM with v0=220 km/s, v_sun=232 km/s, rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3.
